source.model: ElevenLabs Sound Effects model selected by the service

assets.prompt: Seamless close exterior loop of a late-1980s vectored-thrust turbofan at stable idle on a carrier deck: deep compressor body, fine turbine whine, restrained intake hiss, no voices, birds, music or deck announcements, constant level, clean 8-second loop.

candidates.selectionReason: Strongest stable turbine character with useful headroom and no full-scale peak.

runtime.processing: Candidate 03; selected three-second stable cycle with a circular 250 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 2 dB attenuation. The complete seven-second source remains archived.

assets.prompt: Seamless exterior loop of a compact military turbofan at high dry thrust, dense exhaust roar, intake rush and controlled turbine layer, no afterburner, no doppler pass, no clipping, no voices, steady 8-second loop suitable for pitch modulation.

candidates.selectionReason: Best balance of dense dry-thrust body, controlled turbine detail and peak headroom.

runtime.processing: Candidate 02; circular 150 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 2 dB attenuation. The short 1.5-second source remains subject to in-game repetition listening approval.

assets.prompt: Seamless cockpit-adjacent airframe wind loop for fast low-altitude jet flight, broad turbulent rush with light panel vibration, no engine, rain, whistles, speech or impacts, neutral constant intensity, clean 8-second loop.

candidates.selectionReason: Broadest usable airflow texture with the least limiting and sufficient peak headroom.

runtime.processing: Candidate 03; selected three-second stable cycle with a circular 300 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 4 dB attenuation. The complete eight-second source remains archived.

assets.prompt: Seamless vectored-thrust hover downwash loop above a steel carrier deck: powerful low jet wash, turbulent reflected roar and light deck rattle, no voices or alarms, no rhythmic pulsing, stable 8-second loop.

candidates.selectionReason: Most convincing sustained downwash and reflected deck body; attenuation restores safe mix headroom.

runtime.processing: Candidate 02; selected three-second stable cycle with a circular 300 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 5 dB attenuation. The complete eight-second source remains archived.

assets.prompt: Short close mechanical sound of four vectored-thrust jet nozzles rotating together under engine load. Heavy hydraulic actuator movement, precise metal linkage, restrained mechanical lock and a brief natural change in exhaust resonance as the nozzle angle changes. Approximately 1.2 seconds with a clean editable tail. No speech, warning beep, explosion, landing gear, exaggerated machinery or cinematic bass hit.

candidates.selectionReason: Best combination of useful level and peak headroom without reaching digital full scale.

runtime.processing: Candidate 03; tempo-adjusted to retain the complete action in 1.2 seconds; centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM; 12 ms fade-in, 90 ms fade-out and 2 dB attenuation.
